builds.name: Reese's Punch
builds.desc:
This build utilizes the owl feature of Katarina's Legendary Weapon in order to turn her into a serviceable enemy phase unit with good support abilities.
The optimal boon for this set is +Def. While this may seem counterintuitive at first, because this is a Close Counter set, she needs all the defense to not get OHKO'd as she can get, and the super boon really helps her in this regard. Given that most enemies initiating on her will hit her defense, whether it's a dragon or a physical unit, defense becomes the premium defensive stat. This means that the bane choices for her are -Res or -Spd. Given Katarina's good base resistance, she can afford to take a hit to that and still ploy the enemies she needs to ploy well. However, because most units won't be able to double her with the owl effects in play, even with a speed bane, taking a speed hit isn't the worst either.
